product_summary: Per the company's own website (manipalnatural.com, homepage, accessed for this review): 'Manipal Natural manufactures botanical extracts and exports to the global nutraceutical market'. Listed products: Botanical Extracts, Organic Botanical Extracts, Food and Beverage Ingredients, and branded ingredients Curcuman (turmeric extract), Bacopal (Bacopa monnieri), Ocuflora (Tagetes erecta / marigold lutein), Salpick (Salacia reticulata), Asvaman (Withania somnifera). Full product tiles on the homepage: Garcinia, Turmeric, Lutein (Marigold), Bacopa, Sesame, Holy basil, Lycopene, Green coffee bean, Ashwagandha, Triphala, White kidney bean, Amla, Tribulus, Locorise, Boswellia, Coleus, Kalmegh, Cinnamonum, Black pepper, Bitter melon, Gymnema, Beta carotene, Zeaxanthin, plus Senna leaves powder, Organic Amla extract, Organic Curcumin extract, Moringa extract, Lemon peel extract, Marigold extract, Turmeric powder, Shatavari, Coleus, Boswellia. Plant: Bengaluru (Manipal Centre, Bangalore, Karnataka), ~9,290 sq.m / 100,000 sqft, 30,000 kg herbal raw material/day, ISO 22000, GMP, Kosher, Halal, USDA/EU Organic, FSSAI. Note: sub-pages (/products/, /botanical-extracts/, /food-and-beverage-ingredients/, /about-us/, /contact/) returned HTTP 404 at review time, so the catalogue could not be read beyond the homepage; search engine was unavailable (connection refused), so no independent corroboration was possible.
role_hint: manufacturer (own extraction plant in Bengaluru, ISO 8 / Class 100,000 cleanrooms, in-house R&D and QC; no trader signs found on the site). Not verified against registries — out of scope for this review.
comment: Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a MISCLASSIFICATION of the core business: the company is a botanical/herbal extract manufacturer for nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, pharma and personal care, not an FMCG food producer. Correct industry: botanical extracts / nutraceutical ingredients (B2B). HS mapping: the declared set 090620 (cinnamon), 091012 (crushed/ground pepper), 151590 (other fixed vegetable oils), 330129 (other essential oils) does NOT match the actual product line. The site shows 'Cinnamonum' and 'Black pepper' only as EXTRACT lines, not as raw spices of ch.09 — so 090620 and 091012 look like a mis-mapping of extract products; the correct heading for the bulk of the range is 130219 (vegetable extracts), with 320300 for the colouring extracts (annatto, lutein, lycopene, beta-carotene, zeaxanthin) and 091030 for turmeric powder. 151590 and 330129 are not corroborated by any product visible on the site — no fixed oils and no essential oils are listed; they may relate to unlisted lines (e.g. sesame oil, lemon peel oil) but this is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, verdict accepted_hs_corrected — declared codes should be replaced by 130219 + 320300 + 091030 as the primary range, with 151590/330129 kept only if the exporter can produce a customs line. Product lines missing from the declaration: all botanical extracts (the entire core business), organic-certified extracts, colouring extracts, and food & beverage ingredient blends. No customs/B-L record was checked in this review (out of scope), therefore every product claim above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — sourced only to the company's own website, not to a shipment record.
